purpose: Turn authorized scattered know-how into a practical reference the next teammate can actually use.

story.origin_narrative: Brand positioning story, not a claim about company founding history. The answer may already be written down, somewhere. The Knowledge Desk exists to bridge the distance between having information and knowing where to begin.
story.core_belief: Useful knowledge is findable, attributable and transferable.

signature_phrase: Find the knowledge. Put it to work.

personality.tone: welcoming, editorial, orderly; explain rather than overwhelm

design_system.typography: editorial serif accents with clean accessible sans body
design_system.motif: index tabs, filing margins and card dividers

relationship.parent_visibility: Small endorsement after the individual product story; never replace product identity
relationship.payment: Original exact-price Systemia Stripe checkout only; no rebranding of Stripe product without separate approval

governance.visual_identity_direction: Custom CSS motif; not a registered logo or legal mark
